correctness.rationale: The transform uses the curling number of each nonempty prefix, with no extra initial 1. An overlap has length 2p+1 and period p, and a cube always contains one, so in overlap-free words a suffix square exactly detects curling number 2. If an admissible prefix is extended, all newly introduced forbidden factors on either side end at the new position; this establishes the exact prefix induction including termination. Independently enumerated every labeled candidate using integer symbol masks: compare the low p bits for suffix squares and p+1 bits for suffix overlaps against their p-shifts, on both source and transform as appropriate. Replay: python3 /workspace/reproduction/4.py; see 4.txt. The counts at depths 83,84,85 were 5040,6048,0. The only outputs match the exact stated H with tails 1 and 2, with frequencies 4032 and 2016. In letter order 0,1,2, the only nonempty final branching tuples are (1,1,2), (1,2,1), (2,1,1), each at 672 distinct parents; thus all three letters work at every one of the 2016 extendible parents, and exactly one gives curling digit 2. A separate labeled check recomputing factors and curling numbers directly agreed. These are complete finite enumerations, not probability or extrapolation. The frozen computation logs were inspected as recorded evidence, not relied on for independent confirmation.
